blocks.text: A CPA in Tampa Prepares You for Life Events That May Affect Your Tax Status

Life throws a lot of changes at us, many of which will have a direct bearing on what we owe the federal government in taxes. Obviously, winning the lottery is one way to advance to a higher tax bracket. But changes won’t always be that dramatic, that instantaneous, or that fortunate.

A [CPA in Tampa](http://www.reliancecpa.com/) from Reliance Consulting, LLC, can help you prepare financially for life-changing events. Since 1984, Reliance Consulting has been one of the Tampa Bay area’s premier accounting firms, helping thousands of individuals and hundreds of Florida businesses with tax preparation, retirement planning, estate planning, and more.
